question: What activity and cessation are attributed to the dhananjaya vital air?
premises: Dhananjaya may enter into the resonance of sound.
Dhananjaya is also described as subsiding.
Its movement and cessation are both indicated.
inference: Dhananjaya may enter the realm of sound and then subsides.
plain_english: Dhananjaya may enter into the resonance of sound and then subsides.
